posts.name: Dave Meltzer
posts.quote: He was a genius.  His legacy is very complex.  I can't begin to tell you how much I learned from him, and everyone who spent time  talking to him learned.  But the biggest lesson is if you  walk away from wrestling for five years, it is a completely different world from when you left.  Although he was smart enough in the late 2000s to go to ROH, didn't fully grasp the style at all, but felt it had the greatest fan base he'd ever seen and complemented what the talent did inside the ring.
